senses.gloss: ch. same.Part. חָדֵיק pricking, injuring (by being forced into).
units: <cite ref="Shabbat 78b:3">Sabb. 78ᵇ</cite> <he>כיון דח׳ במנא</he> Ms. M. because a rope injures a vessel by being forced into a hole (ed. <he>חריק</he>, v. <cite ref="H01761"><he>חֲרַק</he></cite>).

senses.gloss: to force into, to fill a gap.
units: <cite ref="Yoma 72a:9">Yoma 72ᵃ</cite> <he>חדְּקִינְהוּ</he> fasten them by forcing the chords through the rings.
<cite ref="Shabbat 125b:4">Sabb. 125ᵇ</cite> <he>כיון דחַדְּקָהּ</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>דהַ׳</he>) since he squeezed the stone in (made it immovable).
